issue.title: MAVSDK remote control hangs
issue.body:
Hi, i was trying to to use the MAVSDK python library to communicate with a drone in a  simulation ( the simulation is based on the PX4 repository using gazebo has a simulation tool ) hosted on a different machine. When i run the simulation and try :

``
drone = System()
await drone.connect(system_address="udp://ip_addr_of_target_machine:14540")
``

the script remains hanged, while on the simulation logs im able to see:

`INFO [mavlink] partner IP: ip_addr_of_MAVSDK_machine
`

Now looking on the [PX4 documentation](https://docs.px4.io/v1.12/en/simulation/) i read that there are a series of option in order to achieve what i want to do , i tried  **Enable UDP Broadcasting** , **Enable Streaming to Specific Address**,and   **Use MAVLink Router**, without being able to get any result.

Can anyone help me understand  if i am doing something wrong or the PX4 docu solution should be modified?
Thanks

comments.body:
You have it backwards. You can't connect to UDP 14540 being published on another computer.

What you can do is:
```python
drone = System()
await drone.connect(system_address="udp://:14540")
```

And now enable broadcast, or specifically set the IP in PX4 `mavlink start ... -t IP`.
Actually the UDP port that i am using is 14550 on the mavsdk side i followed [this](https://docs.px4.io/v1.12/en/simulation/#use-mavlink-routerl)

And does this work then?

```python
drone = System()
await drone.connect(system_address="udp://:14550")
```
And your problem is when the simulator is running on another machine? Do you have mavlink-router running on that other machine and sending MAVLink to the machine that is running MAVSDK?
yeah i got mavlink router running on the machine with the STL and from the other machine i am using mavsdk for comunicating
I've also read [this issue](https://github.com/mavlink/MAVSDK/issues/2149), where the guy was using the port 18570 on mavsdk side
Can you show your mavlink-router configuration file?

This my config file:

```

[UdpEndpoint QGC]
Mode = Normal
Address = 192.168.124.1 # MAVSDK machine
Port = 14550

[UdpEndpoint SIM]
Mode = Eavesdropping
Address = 127.0.0.1 # SITL
Port = 14550

```
Seems like it should work with `udp://:14550` on the MAVSDK machine... :thinking:
Wait you mean that on the mavsdk machine i should use the localhost for connecting?
Seems like it. Does QGC receive MAVLink if you run it instead of MAVSDK on your MAVSDK machine?
You mean launching QgroundControl with mavlink forwarding enable where i specify the IP addres of the MAVSDK machine?
No, just launch QGC and verify that it can talk to the drone. If QGC doesn't work either, then it means that there is something wrong with your network setup.
Ok but QGControl on the SITL machine or the mavsdk machine ? because if i launch it on the SITL machine it is able to detect the drone
Yes Qgroundcontrol works and is able to detect the other machine
Ok i tried with another machine and it seems to work fine, i don't really know what was the problem, thanks for the time that you've dedicated me anyway
